task:
FIX THE FIVE OPEN REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #806 (docs(finder): F2d design -- wide-row archetype product and product attachment). Update only the existing branch codex/run-38082651056-1; its head must be 1a1fb58bdf6c840f698e31b5b839ac099aa80953 -- if it is not, stop and report the SHA you found.

SCOPE GUARD: do NOT change this PR's recorded owner answer to question 8 or any wording about purging. The owner reversed that decision on 2026-10-11; the reversal is handled in a separate pull request (#808) that will be rebased onto this one after it merges, and competing edits here would conflict with it.

THE FINDINGS, AS THE REVIEWER WROTE THEM (line numbers are at 1a1fb58):

[F1] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md:669 -- **Bind completeness derivation into the model digest** Fresh evidence after the scoring-call-graph fix is that this semantic manifest still omits the rule that derives `completeness_ppm` as `min(system_rating_vector.completeness) × 100`. That transformation lives in the builder, outside the `fit_all` call graph, and the proposed frozen test starts with an already-derived `completeness_ppm`; changing the source rule in both builder and validator would therefore alter every stored weighted key without changing `archetype_model_sha256`, causing F4 to present different rankings as comparable. Hash the derivation rule or its helper and test from raw rating-vector completeness values. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L26-L28](https://github.com/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/blob/1a1fb58bdf6c840f698e31b5b839ac099aa80953/AGENTS.md#L26-L28)

[F2] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md:1444 -- **Correct the rollout dependency step references** These adjacent dependencies point to the wrong steps: the calibration histogram is produced in step 5, not step 4, and the deployed release is step 4, not step 8 (which is the Archetype build). An implementation following these references can bind the footprint to the wrong prerequisite or look for a nonexistent step-8 release attestation, undermining the required deploy-before-build/publication order. Update both references to the steps defined by this table and the controlling ROADMAP. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L36-L40](https://github.com/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/blob/1a1fb58bdf6c840f698e31b5b839ac099aa80953/AGENTS.md#L36-L40)

[F3] docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md:219 -- **Remove the obsolete fresh-generation rollout instructions** After adding the final wide-row layout here, this production-status document still instructs readers at lines 221–247 to size a complete fresh generation and says the governed actions cannot be finalized until step 4 creates that generation. The controlling ROADMAP now explicitly attaches both products to the already-existing `parallel_v1` generation and creates no fresh generation, so following this supporting rollout document blocks action development on an event that will never occur and applies the obsolete 1.174-TB capacity calculation. Rewrite or clearly supersede that trailing block. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L36-L43](https://github.com/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/blob/1a1fb58bdf6c840f698e31b5b839ac099aa80953/AGENTS.md#L36-L43)

[F4] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md:1736 -- **Carry probe approval into the capacity action** Fresh evidence after the ROADMAP disposition is that this executable PR4 checklist validates only histogram presence, `Σ_all`, footprint provenance, and free space; it never requires `coefficient_decision: accepted` or equality between the probe's code/coefficient identity and the manifest the Archetype builder will register. The focused refusal tests at lines 1999–2002 omit both cases as well, so implementing this list can launch the immutable build using a complete but explicitly rejected histogram, or one measured with different scoring logic. Add both fail-closed checks and their refusal tests to the action requirements. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L26-L28](https://github.com/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/blob/1a1fb58bdf6c840f698e31b5b839ac099aa80953/AGENTS.md#L26-L28)

[F5] docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md:1613 -- **Emit the metrics required by the capacity gate** This PR1 task says to apply the final migration and size the heap and indexes, but the current `_sizes()` receipt exposes only `table_bytes_per_row`, aggregate `index_bytes_per_row`, and a per-index map. The PR4 gate later refuses unless the receipt directly carries `heap_bytes_per_row`, `primary_key_bytes_per_row`, `weighted_index_bytes_per_row`, and especially `tier_index_bytes_per_row_per_unit_fraction`; PR4's file list does not revisit this script. Following the stated PR1 work therefore produces a valid measurement that the mandatory pre-build gate cannot consume. Require these four normalized fields and tests in the PR1 script contract. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L26-L28](https://github.com/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/blob/1a1fb58bdf6c840f698e31b5b839ac099aa80953/AGENTS.md#L26-L28)

FOR EACH FINDING: first verify it against the files at the head commit and decide whether it is correct. Fix every correct finding in the files this PR already changes; for a finding you judge incorrect, change nothing for it. Do not widen scope beyond these findings. Keep every existing negative assertion in any test. Run every test that reads a file you change (and bash -n / ruff check where relevant) and make sure they pass. Do not contact production.
